scripts.test: turbo run test && bun run test:ml && bun run test:research
scripts.test:ml: cd apps/ml && sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo "apps/ml/.venv is missing — see apps/ml/README.md#tests"; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/python -m pytest'
scripts.test:research: cd research && sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo "research/.venv is missing — see research/README.md"; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/python -m pytest'
scripts.docker:local:tools: bun run --cwd=infra/docker docker compose --profile tools up -d
